correctness.rationale: For nonzero t all five component factors are reduced and the moving conic is smooth. The fixed base has 3 nodes plus 3 tacnodes. Its six moving line-conic intersections and four moving conic-conic intersections are exhaustive by Bezout. The only conic-conic collision is discriminant t^2+4=0, producing two tacnodes, and the only contact with a pre-existing line-line node is t^2=1, producing one transverse D4 triple point. Thus the ADE baskets and Tjurina totals 22,23,24 follow. The multiplication matrices Phi_3,Phi_4,Phi_5 have generic characteristic-zero ranks 30,43,56. Exact indexed minors have gcd support t=0 (degree 3), t=0 and t^2+4 (degree 4), and determinant support t=0, t^2=1 and t^2+4 (degree 5). Exact ranks at t=1 are 43,55 and at t=2i are 42,54; x->-x covers minus signs. Hence AR dimensions (2,7),(2,8),(3,9), mdr=4, and the exponent-sum obstruction to free/plus-one generated cases. Both scripts replayed successfully with characteristic-zero arithmetic; no finite-field inference is used.

value.rationale: The natural deformation of the authors’ own conic-addition counterexample stays outside free and plus-one generation for every smooth member; two distinct geometric mechanisms produce different precise jumps in the graded Jacobian module. Determining all exceptional parameters and both graded dimensions is a complete, motivated deformation picture, not an arbitrary scalar evaluation or textbook restatement. Its exactness may guide general deletion/addition criteria for conics; no downstream theorem is falsely asserted.
